title: Chinese Face Solo #08 (중국 · 30대 · 혀 내밀기(관능) · 메이크업 걸크러시(강화) · 피어싱 P100+쥬얼리 · 스티커 야광 초승달(관자놀이) · 헤나 붉은 갈색 · 혀 분리된 혀+양쪽 스터드 + 송곳니)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and the tops of her collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 30s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Chinese woman — Chinese poised refined beauty luminous fair porcelain complexion with a neutral-rose undertone and clear glass-skin glow, mid 30s, hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum, long glossy dark-brown waves swept to one side. Real pores and fine skin grain on her skin, a soft sheen of natural oils, large eyes with bright real catchlights, full lips, extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip, a small glow-in-the-dark crescent moon sticker at each temple, softly glowing neon blue-green against the dark, all stickers flat on the skin, clear of the eyes and lids and clear of the piercings, fine deep reddish-brown henna mehndi line patterns of vines and dots painted across the forehead only, well clear of the eyes and brows, heavy-lidded eyes, lips parted, her tongue stretched out long and low with its tip reaching down past the lower lip toward the chin, the tongue deeply forked like a snake's, split down the middle for most of its length, the two pointed tips clearly separated and curling slightly apart, with a small matching barbell stud through each half of the fork, one ball on top and one underneath, two sharp pointed vampire fangs showing, a sultry, teasing expression — a photograph of a real Chinese woman's face (East Asian Chinese features: a longer oval face with prominent high cheekbones and a defined jawline, long upturned phoenix-shaped eyes with sharp inner folds, a high strong nose bridge, thin arched eyebrows with a slight rise, balanced lips), not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light 

Piercings: An extreme, dense armour of about one hundred real rose-gold piercings with a few rose-gold coin drops among them covering the face: a thick rose-gold septum ring with a smaller ring above it and two rose-gold rings through each nostril; a straight rose-gold bar across the bridge of the nose between the brows; five rose-gold pieces in a row along the outer half of each eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; two rows of four small rose-gold studs across the forehead above the brows; four small studs up each temple on the bone, well clear of the eyes; a row of six small studs along each cheekbone; a rose-gold Medusa stud above the lips; a big rose-gold hoop, two smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and five small hoops along the upper lip's edge; a rose-gold labret stud and four rings through the chin; five small studs along each jaw; on each ear a full dense row of ten oversized hoops, thick bars, stretched plugs, helix rings and studs from lobe to top, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and eight fine rose-gold chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings and the septum ring. The piercings are packed so densely that the rows touch and overlap, leaving only hairline gaps of bare skin between them, until the face reads as a single armour of metal; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. Each piece carries small mixed gemstones (diamond, pearl, opal, amethyst, ruby and sapphire) set into alternating pieces. All jewelry is real rose gold, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Jewelry: besides the piercings she wears well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of platinum necklaces and chains resting on her neck and collarbones, and well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of platinum hair ornaments set in her hair, all of it real, without covering her eyes, her face or her piercings.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
